lines.say: [gravelly, tired] Krieg's world burned itself to ash... and its soldiers STILL die for the Emperor.
lines.text: KRIEG'S WORLD BURNED ITSELF TO ASH... AND ITS SOLDIERS STILL DIE FOR THE EMPEROR.

lines.say: [grim] No. They rebelled against him five hundred years ago. And lost.
lines.text: NO. THEY REBELLED AGAINST HIM FIVE HUNDRED YEARS AGO. AND LOST.

lines.say: [confused] Then why fight for him now?
lines.text: THEN WHY FIGHT FOR HIM NOW?

lines.say: [grim] Penance. Every Kriegsman owes a debt, and pays it by dying in battle.
lines.text: PENANCE. EVERY KRIEGSMAN OWES A DEBT, AND PAYS IT BY DYING IN BATTLE.

lines.say: [coldly] Imagine an army that fears nothing. Not death. Not you. Not me.
lines.text: IMAGINE AN ARMY THAT FEARS NOTHING. NOT DEATH. NOT YOU. NOT ME.

lines.say: [quietly] And the Emperor just... accepts that?
lines.text: AND THE EMPEROR JUST... ACCEPTS THAT?

lines.say: [dry, unimpressed] Everything, Private. Krieg just keeps the receipt.
lines.text: EVERYTHING, PRIVATE. KRIEG JUST KEEPS THE RECEIPT.

lines.say: [small voice] ...Sarge? Why does he still fight for the Emperor?
lines.text: ...SARGE? WHY DOES HE STILL FIGHT FOR THE EMPEROR?

hum: Low distant war drone and rumbling, ominous
zap: Distant explosion boom with ringing echo, short
puff: Man exhales a long puff of cigar smoke, slow breath
page: Comic book page turning quickly, paper whoosh
whoosh: Quick soft camera whoosh swipe transition

music: Slow melancholy gothic choir and low cello, grim then darkly comic, sparse, instrumental, no vocals, 70 bpm
